scares.description: A little girl is happily riding her tricycle when, out of nowhere, the music cuts out and the imposing shadow of the house suddenly appears, startling her.
nevercracker suffers a heart attack and falls on a child
As Officers Landers and Lester investigate the property, the tree in the yard suddenly comes to life and violently lashes out at the patrol car.
When Jenny tries to leave a flyer at the door, the welcome mat suddenly comes to life like a giant tongue, dragging her inside.
Mientras los niños exploran las entrañas oscuras de la casa, una corriente de aire y objetos saltan de golpe desde los conductos, acompañado de un fuerte estruendo musical.
